openItems.title: Get International Driving Permit (IDP)
openItems.description: Europcar Spain requires US license holders to present an IDP. Without it, they can refuse the car at the PMI counter. $20 at any AAA branch, 15 min, valid 1 year. Must be obtained in the US before departure. Covers Greece too.

openItems.title: Fix Avis Crete pickup time
openItems.description: Booked for 9:00 PM but flight doesn't land until 9:30 PM. Contact Avis to push to 10:00-10:30 PM. Confirm CHQ counter hours. Call Avis Greece: +30 28210 83952. Get confirmation in writing.

openItems.title: Fix Avis Crete drop-off vs. flight departure
openItems.description: Drop-off booked for 10:30 AM Jul 7 but flight departs 8:20 AM. Arrange early-morning key-drop or return car evening of Jul 6 and taxi to airport Jul 7.

openItems.title: Verify easyJet name for Mom
openItems.description: "Malakalsadat Jalalzadeh Kasmaei Nejad" is 50+ characters. Booking exists (KCNWVNK) so it cleared the system, but verify in easyJet Manage Bookings that the boarding pass name matches passport exactly. If truncated, call easyJet before Jun 26.

openItems.title: Confirm PMI to CHQ bag tags at check-in
openItems.description: The ARN connection is 70 min on the same SAS ticket. Bags should through-check PMI to CHQ, but verify at PMI check-in. If tagged to ARN, you'd have to reclaim and re-check in 70 min.

openItems.title: ATH transit: reclaim bags between separate tickets
openItems.description: SKY express (CHQ to ATH) and Delta (ATH to ATL) are separate tickets. Bags will NOT auto-transfer. Exit domestic arrivals, reclaim, re-check at Delta international. 2h 55m connection is sufficient but don't linger.
